name: bridge-monorepo
description: Production monorepo for Bridge — Desktop Electron App and Chrome Extension with Shared TypeScript Package

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @bridge/shared build && pnpm --filter @bridge/desktop build && pnpm --filter @bridge/extension build
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/*/dist apps/*/out packages/*/dist
